name: openfold3-ubiquitin-fp16-l0
benchmark_exclusion_reason: Structure generation is qualified by the model-owned native sampler rather than a catalog token workload.

testcases.name: openfold3-ubiquitin-fp16-l0
testcases.notes: Builds all 18 TensorRT plans from the digest-pinned public OpenBind checkpoint using the default mixed-FP16 policy, runs the native 200-step sampler twice, and gates deterministic standards-compliant structure and confidence invariants. Accuracy parity is retained as separately recorded L1 qualification evidence.
